description: Election Commission - Local Authorities Elections Ordenance Notice under Section 10A(1)(b), Weligama Urban Council
reasoning: This gazette notice specifically concerns electoral matters under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It declares that a candidate has forfeited their rights to remain on a nomination paper for the Weligama Urban Council due to ceasing membership in their political party. This falls directly under election administration and candidate registration matters, which is the core focus of Type 7 (Elections Gazettes).
